name: finsphere-backend
description: Backend REST API service for FinSphere Personal Finance Application

scripts.build: cp -f .env.default .env 2>/dev/null || echo 'DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db"' > .env; prisma generate && prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node prisma/seed.js && cp -f prisma/dev.db ./dev.db 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.start: cp -f .env.default .env 2>/dev/null || echo 'DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db"' > .env; prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node src/start.js
